acceptance_criteria.text: Hosted Supabase migration history is aligned with the four committed migration versions using a supported migration-history workflow; a synthetic Auth actor/workspace exists; required provider configuration is private; no real jobs/browser state are affected; product cron remains disabled.
Hosted RPC/lease/heartbeat/retry boundaries and encrypted synthetic browser-state persist, separate-process reuse, reset, and exact cleanup pass.

One isolated synthetic Edge dispatch is accepted idempotently and completes in GitHub cloud execution with the Owner PC able to be off; the temporary dispatch target is restored and product cron stays disabled.
Evidence explicitly distinguishes LOCAL_HERMETIC, CI, HOSTED, and future LIVE readiness and contains no credential, token, cookie, JWT, browser state, or student PII.
Stable final candidate passes required current-head verify CI, fresh exact-head Qualified Review, Controller readiness, and has no unresolved safety or scope blocker.
No Phase 3/4/6 expansion, no live Teaching/LMS write, no automatic Zalo send, no CAPTCHA/OTP bypass, no new schema/RLS redesign, and model routing remains manual.
